title: Outdoor Jacket A: restore its color map and reconstruct the missing surface basis
notes: Uses the pinned PS3 source and overlay-port donor. Restores the jacket Color1 map and reconstructs normals/tangents from unchanged PS4 positions, UVs, and triangle lists. Donor: the pre-hat-colour jacket that step keeps as work/backup-hat-colour/mp-kit-hunter-torso-jacket-a.pak (SHA-256 065ee28fa8e99bd8aab43d7008c98091fe27cd53166a3b6178cb9a0973aa9985); work/backup-outdoor-jacket/donor.pak (070e2c95...) is used instead when present.
